title: Active Avoidance Protocol
author: Teresa Macheda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbu6inze

steps.title: Check system functionality
steps.instruction: Turn on the computer, verify the Avoidance system is plugged in and powered, open GEMINI.exe, select Run → Diagnostics, and use the chamber controls to confirm the box operates correctly.

steps.title: Create new study database
steps.instruction: In GEMINI, choose File → Create new study database, give the file a name ending with the .mdb extension, click Open, and acknowledge the connecting window by clicking OK.

steps.title: Define active avoidance protocol
steps.instruction: Add a Protocol Record with the following fields: Protocol ID = active avoidance, CS Type = House, US Type = Shock, Gate = Open, Misc. = Assume location/Co‑Terminate CS/US, Trial type = Active, Acclimation = 300 sec, Accl Interval = 30 sec, CS Duration = 10 sec, US Duration = 2 sec, Max trial Length = 12 sec (auto‑calculated), Max Num Trial = 50. Then add an ITI Record named “Min/Max” with Min = 25 sec, Max = 35 sec, Delta = 5 sec, Quantity = 49, click Generate Random, and finally Save the protocol record.

steps.title: Create session and add subjects
steps.instruction: Click the triangle‑star/pen icon, select Session, add a session record and fill in a Session ID (name and date), OK. Under Protocol ID choose the active avoidance protocol. Click Subjects, enter a Group ID and a random Group Order number, add the subject record (or select an existing Subject ID), assign the correct station/chamber, preload the session to trial, then click Run → Trial and type your user login when prompted.

steps.title: Prepare testing chamber
steps.instruction: Clean the chamber floor and walls, place fresh bedding in the tray beneath the grid floor.

steps.title: Set shock intensity on box
steps.instruction: Turn on the Gemini box, set the PROGRAM/MANUAL switch to MANUAL, set the RUN/ADJUST switch to Adjust, turn the CURRENT ADJUST knob until the desired shock current (read on the SHOCK INTENSITY (mA) display) is reached, then return the RUN/ADJUST switch to the centered position.

steps.title: Run active avoidance trial for mouse
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in either the right or left compartment, shut the door, press Start on the Gemini box; after a 5‑minute habituation period the program will automatically deliver 50 trials as defined in the protocol.

steps.title: Clean chamber between subjects
steps.instruction: After each mouse, clean the chamber floor and walls again to keep shock intensity consistent.

steps.title: Repeat testing for all mice and days
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 5–7 for every mouse in the cohort, and repeat the entire daily sequence for 5 consecutive days.

steps.title: Export session data to Excel
steps.instruction: Click Reports, select the desired Session ID, choose Export to Excel File, specify the file location, name the file, and click OK to save.

steps.title: Final cleaning and animal return
steps.instruction: Empty the chamber tray of bedding, clean the drawer and chamber floor/walls, and return all mice to their home rooms.
